_doc: GNN model card of an ensemble of the GNN codes, stating what that code did implicitly; converted with python -m grand_gnn_train.convert_legacy. See README.md.
name: pgnn_direction_xy
description: pGNN direction (ICRC/paper ensemble). Converted from the GNN codes (GNNScaleMDN of GNN_forICRC, notebook 'applied_on_data 2026'): 6 node features with delta_t, which that code did not normalise (its NormaliseLayer mask had 5 entries); delta_t computed with the speed c*1.00014 as make_delta_t did. Trigger: 5 sigma with 15 ADC per channel, i.e. 5*15*sqrt(2) = 106.07 ADC on x, y (the GP300_106ADC datasets); knn_k 8.
